propositions: Review gate runners cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, budget-shed, or resumed work, allowing plan-review failures to become empty successful checkpoints and code-review losses of earlier work when later criteria fail.

A new independent discovery submodule with typed DiscoveryStagePlan/DiscoveryUnitPlan inputs and six typed per-unit outcomes must execute with dependency-aware scheduling, deterministic budget shedding, and preserve successful independent results on partial failure.

The versioned digest-complete checkpoint envelope must cover material, code/ref, effective-policy snapshot, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, dependencies, and schema version so identity is deterministic; only success and content-identical resumed units round-trip as reusable.

Budget shedding must be deterministic in ascending (dependency rank, unit id) order with minimal identical shed sets across runs, treating cap_override=None as centrality-scaled computed cap, 0.0 as valid shed-all, and never shedding container criteria.

Cancellation observation occurs before dispatch; already-dispatched non-interruptible calls commit their true success/failed outcome with real usage, while not-yet-dispatched units are marked cancelled with exact completed-so-far accounting.

Stored trace serialization must contain normalized outcome metadata and lineage excluding raw prompts, ticket/context bodies, provider payloads, and secrets, with no per-unit trace added to review/review-status contracts.
